muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: يا is a vocative particle; ﴿أي﴾ is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma; ها is for drawing attention (tanbīh); الذين is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾; and the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿لا تتخذوا عدوي وعدوكم أولياء﴾: لا is prohibitive; تتخذوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لا﴾, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); عدوي is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); عدوكم is conjoined to عدوي; and أولياء is the second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿تلقون إليهم بالمودة﴾: تلقون is a verb and its fāʿil, and the mafʿūl bihi is omitted; the meaning of the bāʾ in ﴿بالمودة﴾ is then causal, as though it were said: ﴿تلقون إليهم أسرار رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وأخباره بسبب المودة التي بينكم﴾ ("you convey to them the secrets of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and his news because of the affection between you"). إليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تلقون﴾. بالمودة is a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to ﴿تلقون﴾. It has also been said: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant), and المودة is itself the mafʿūl bihi of ﴿تلقون﴾. As for the clause ﴿تلقون﴾, there are four views about it:
The first: that it is explicative (tafsīriyya) of their taking them as allies.
The second: that it is resumptive; on these two views it has no grammatical position.
The third: that it is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of ﴿تتخذوا﴾, i.e. "do not take [them as allies], conveying affection".
The fourth: that it is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أولياء﴾.
﴿وقد كفروا بما جاءكم من الحق﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); كفروا is a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl from لا تتخذوا, or from تلقون; بما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿كفروا﴾; the clause ﴿جاءكم﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and من الحق is a ḥāl.
﴿يخرجون الرسول وإياكم أن تؤمنوا بالله ربكم﴾: the clause ﴿يخرجون...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl from the pronoun in ﴿كفروا﴾. الرسول is the mafʿūl bihi, accusative by the fatḥa. إياكم is conjoined to الرسول; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن تؤمنوا﴾ is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "because of your believing in Allah"; ﴿بالله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تؤمنوا﴾; and ربكم is a badal (substitute).
﴿إن كنتم خرجتم جهادا في سبيلي وابتغاء مرضاتي﴾: إن is conditional; كنتم is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the tāʾ is its noun (ism); the clause خرجتم is the khabar (predicate) of كنتم; جهادًا is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi, or a ḥāl, i.e. "in the state of your being strivers"; and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by His words: لا تتخذوا.
﴿تسرون إليهم بالمودة﴾: the clause تسرون is either resumptive, with no grammatical position, or it follows ﴿تلقون إليهم﴾ as a badal of part from whole (badal baʿḍ min kull); تسرون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil; the mafʿūl bihi is omitted; and بالمودة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تسرون﴾, or the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila) on the object.
﴿وأنا أعلم بما أخفيتم وما أعلنتم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial. أنا is the mubtadaʾ (subject). أعلم is the khabar. بما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أعلم﴾. The clause أخفيتم is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. Or ﴿أعلم﴾ is an imperfect verb; and ﴿ما أعلنتم﴾ is conjoined to ﴿بما أخفيتم﴾.
﴿ومن يفعله منكم فقد ضل سواء السبيل﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, or the wāw is resumptive and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; من is a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ; يفعله is the protasis, its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو), and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; the fāʾ links the apodosis of the condition because it is joined with قد; ضل is a verb, its fāʿil is "he" (هو), and سواء السبيل is its object; it has also been said that ضل is intransitive, so سواء السبيل is accusative as an adverb of place (ẓarfiyya makāniyya).

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿إن يثقفوكم يكونوا لكم أعداء﴾: إن is conditional; يثقفوكم is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); يكونوا is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), jussive, the sign of its jussive also being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its noun (ism) and أعداء is its khabar (predicate); and لكم is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ويبسطوا إليكم أيديهم وألسنتهم بالسوء﴾: conjoined to يكونوا; إليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يبسطوا﴾; أيديهم is the mafʿūl bihi; ألسنتهم is conjoined to أيديهم; and بالسوء is a ḥāl.
﴿وودوا لو تكفرون﴾: also conjoined, to the clause of the condition and its requital; لو is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya); تكفرون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); and the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿لو﴾ and what falls in its scope is the object of ﴿ودوا﴾.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿لن تنفعكم أرحامكم ولا أولادكم﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; لن is a particle of negation, accusative and futurity; تنفعكم is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by لن; the kāf is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أرحامكم is a postponed fāʿil (agent); and لا أولادكم is conjoined to أرحامكم.
﴿يوم القيامة يفصل بينكم﴾: يوم القيامة is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) what precedes it, i.e. "they will not benefit you on the Day of Resurrection", so one pauses on it; or it is attached to what follows it, i.e. "He will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection"; يفصل is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil is "he" (هو); and بينكم is an adverb attached to يفصل in either case.
﴿والله بما تعملون بصير﴾: الله is the mubtadaʾ (subject); بما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿بصير﴾; the clause تعملون is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and بصير is the khabar (predicate) of the Word of Majesty الله.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿قد كانت لكم أسوة حسنة في إبراهيم والذين معه﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); كانت is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of كان; أسوة is its postponed noun (ism); حسنة is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أسوة﴾; في إبراهيم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أسوة﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from it, since it has been described, or attached to an omitted khabar of كانت; الذين is conjoined to إبراهيم; and معه is an adverb of place, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿إذ قالوا لقومهم﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of a genitive (majrūr) as a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from إبراهيم والذين معه, or it is an adverb attached to the khabar of كان; the clause ﴿قالوا﴾ is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and لقومهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قالوا﴾.
﴿إنا برآء منكم ومما تعبدون من دون الله﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and برآء is its khabar; the clause is the object of their saying (maqūl al-qawl); منكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿برآء﴾; مما is conjoined to منكم; the clause تعبدون is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and من دون الله is a ḥāl.
﴿كفرنا بكم﴾: the clause is resumptive within the scope of the saying, with no grammatical position. كفرنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent). بكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿كفرنا﴾.
﴿وبدا بيننا وبينكم العداوة والبغضاء أبدا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. بدا is a past verb. بيننا is an adverb attached to ﴿بدا﴾. بينكم is an adverb conjoined to بيننا; العداوة is the fāʿil; البغضاء is conjoined to العداوة; and أبدًا is an adverb, also attached to ﴿بدا﴾.
﴿حتى تؤمنوا بالله وحده﴾: حتى is a particle of limit and genitive; تؤمنوا is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after حتى; the interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb is genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿أبدًا﴾; بالله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تؤمنوا﴾; and وحده is a ḥāl.
﴿إلا قول إبراهيم لأبيه﴾: إلا is a particle of exception; قول إبراهيم is excepted from أسوة حسنة, because the saying is part of the example, so it is a connected exception (istithnāʾ muttaṣil); it has also been said that it is a disconnected exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ); and لأبيه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قول﴾.
﴿لأستغفرن لك وما أملك لك من الله من شيء﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to a supplied oath; أستغفرن is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "I" (أنا); the clause is the object of the saying; لك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أستعفرن﴾ [Translator's note: so spelled in the source; the verb is أستغفرن]; the wāw is circumstantial, or conjunctive, because the clause is part of the completion of Ibrāhīm's saying, so it is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl from the fāʿil of أستغفرن, i.e. "I will ask forgiveness for you [while not owning…]", so it is built on what precedes it and ordered upon it by way of being a ḥāl; ما is negative; أملك is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "I" (أنا); لك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أملك﴾; من الله is a ḥāl, because it was originally an adjective (ṣifa) of شيء; من is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; and شيء is genitive in form and accusative in position, as the object of أملك.
﴿ربنا عليك توكلنا وإليك أنبنا وإليك المصير﴾: ربنا is the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf; عليك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿توكلنا﴾; إليك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أنبنا﴾; the wāw is a conjunction; إليك is a fronted khabar; and المصير is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿ربنا لا تجعلنا فتنة للذين كفروا﴾: ربنا is the one addressed (munādā), likewise a muḍāf; لا is of request (ṭalabiyya), for supplication; تجعلنا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا; نا is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and فتنة is the second mafʿūl bihi; it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the sense of the agent, i.e. "do not make us a cause of trial for them, by their gaining victory over us", or in the sense of the patient, i.e. "do not make us tried by them, by Your giving them power over us"; للذين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿فتنة﴾ on both interpretations; and the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿واغفر لنا ربنا إنك أنت العزيز الحكيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اغفر is a verb of supplication (fiʿl duʿāʾ); لنا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿اغفر﴾; ربنا is the one addressed, a muḍāf, repeated for emphasis; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the kāf is its noun (ism); أنت is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), or a mubtadaʾ (subject); العزيز is the khabar (predicate) of إن, or the khabar of أنت, and that clause is the khabar of إن; and الحكيم is a second khabar in either case.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿لقد كان لكم فيهم أسوة حسنة لمن كان يرجو الله واليوم الآخر﴾: the clause follows the clause ﴿قد كانت لكم أسوة﴾ as an emphasis of it, brought for intensity in urging the ruling; the lām occurs in the answer to a supplied oath; قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; لكم is its fronted khabar (predicate); فيهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿أسوة﴾; أسوة is the postponed noun (ism) of كان; حسنة is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أسوة﴾; لمن is a badal of part from whole (badal baʿḍ min kull) from ﴿لكم﴾, with repetition of the preposition, and it has been said: a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl); the clause ﴿كان﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The noun of كان is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); the clause يرجو الله is the khabar of كان; and اليوم الآخر is conjoined to the Word of Majesty (lafẓ al-jalāla).
﴿ومن يتول فإن الله هو الغني الحميد﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; من is a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject); يتول is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; the fāʾ links the apodosis; the apodosis is omitted, its implied form being "then the evil consequence of his turning away is upon himself"; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the Word of Majesty is its noun; الغني is the khabar of إن, nominative by the ḍamma; الحميد is a second khabar of إن, nominative by the ḍamma; and the clause has no grammatical position, because it gives the reason for the supplied apodosis.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿عسى الله أن يجعل بينكم وبين الذين عاديتم منهم مودة﴾: عسى is a verb, one of the verbs of hope (afʿāl al-rajāʾ); the Word of Majesty (lafẓ al-jalāla) is its noun (ism); أن يجعل is in the place of the khabar (predicate); بينكم is an adverb (ẓarf) in the place of the second object of يجعل; بين الذين عاديتم is conjoined to the adverb; مودة is the first object of يجعل; and منهم is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from الذين عاديتم.
﴿والله قدير والله غفور رحيم﴾: a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar, and their like conjoined to them.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿لا ينهاكم الله عن الذين لم يقاتلوكم في الدين﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; لا is negative; ينهاكم الله is an imperfect verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and a postponed fāʿil (agent); عن الذين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ينهاكم﴾; the clause ﴿لم يقاتلوكم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. في الدين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يقاتلوكم﴾, i.e. "on its account".
﴿ولم يخرجوكم من دياركم أن تبروهم وتقسطوا إليهم إن الله يحب المقسطين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لم يخرجوكم is conjoined to ﴿لم يقاتلوكم﴾; من دياركم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يخرجوكم﴾; أن تبروهم is in the place of a genitive (majrūr) as a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from الذين; تقسطوا إليهم is conjoined to تبروهم; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the Word of Majesty is its noun (ism), and the clause يحب المقسطين is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿إنما ينهاكم الله عن الذين قاتلوكم في الدين﴾: إنما is a restraining particle and the restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa); ينهاكم الله is an imperfect verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and a postponed fāʿil (agent); عن الذين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ينهاكم﴾; the clause قاتلوكم is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position. في الدين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قاتلوكم﴾.
﴿وأخرجوكم من دياركم وظاهروا على إخراجكم أن تولوهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أخرجوكم is conjoined to قاتلوكم; من دياركم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أخرجوكم﴾; ظاهروا is also conjoined; على إخراجكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ظاهروا﴾, i.e. "they helped in expelling you"; and أن together with what falls in its scope is a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from الذين.
﴿ومن يتولهم فأولئك هم الظالمون﴾: the wāw is resumptive; من is a jussive-governing conditional noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject); يتولهم is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʾ is linking (rābiṭa); the clause أولئك هم الظالمون is in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the protasis together with its apodosis is the khabar (predicate) of من; and the clause ﴿ومن يتولهم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: يا is a vocative particle; أي is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of an accusative (manṣūb); ها is for drawing attention (tanbīh); الذين is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾; and the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿إذا جاءكم المؤمنات مهاجرات فامتحنوهن﴾: إذا is an adverb (ẓarf) of future time, putting its condition in the genitive and made accusative by its apodosis; the clause جاءكم is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) through the adverb's being annexed to it; المؤمنات is a postponed fāʿil (agent); مهاجرات is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the fāʾ is linking (rābiṭa); the clause امتحنوهن has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; امتحنوهن is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, the wāw is the fāʿil, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿الله أعلم بإيمانهن﴾: الله is the mubtadaʾ (subject); أعلم is the khabar (predicate); بإيمانهن is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أعلم﴾, because it is an elative (afʿal tafḍīl); the fāʾ is a conjunction; إن is conditional; علمتموهن is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and it is a verb, its fāʿil, and its first mafʿūl bihi; and مؤمنات is the second mafʿūl bihi. [Translator's note: the source places the analysis of فإن علمتموهن مؤمنات under this phrase, before the next heading.]
﴿فإن علمتموهن مؤمنات فلا ترجعوهن إلى الكفار﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, because it is a clause of request (ṭalabiyya); لا is prohibitive; ترجعوهن is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; and إلى الكفار is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ترجعوهن﴾.
﴿لا هن حل لهم ولا هم يحلون لهن﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, because it is causal (taʿlīliyya), giving the reason for His words ﴿فلا ترجعوهن﴾; لا is negative; هن is a mubtadaʾ and حل is a khabar; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿حل﴾; and لا هم يحلون لهن is conjoined to the preceding clause, parallel to it.
﴿وآتوهم ما أنفقوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; آتوهم is a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi [Translator's note: so in the source; آتوهم is in fact an imperative verb]; the pronoun refers to the disbelievers, i.e. "give their disbelieving husbands what they spent on them"; ما is the second mafʿūl bihi; and the clause أنفقوا is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولا جناح عليكم أن تنكحوهن إذا آتيتموهن أجورهن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is the lā of generic negation; جناح is its noun (ism), indeclinable on the fatḥa; عليكم is the khabar of لا; أن is a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; تنكحوهن is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن; the interpreted maṣdar is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e. "in your marrying them", and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿جناح﴾; إذا is an adverb that includes the sense of condition; the clause آتيتموهن is in the position of a genitive through the adverb's being annexed to it; and أجورهن is the second object of ﴿آتيتموهن﴾.
﴿ولا تمسكوا بعصم الكوافر﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تمسكوا is an imperfect verb, jussive by ﴿لا﴾, and the wāw is the fāʿil; and بعصم الكوافر is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تمسكوا﴾.
﴿واسألوا ما أنفقتم وليسألوا ما أنفقوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اسألوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; ما is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause أنفقتم is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. وليسألوا: the wāw is a conjunction, the lām is the lām of command, and يسألوا is an imperfect verb, jussive by the lām of command; ما is the mafʿūl bihi; and the clause أنفقوا is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿ذلكم حكم الله يحكم بينكم﴾: ذلكم is the mubtadaʾ, the reference being to the ruling given in the verses; حكم الله is the khabar; the clause ﴿يحكم بينكم﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or a ḥāl from حكم الله; and بينكم is an adverb attached to ﴿يحكم﴾.
﴿والله عليم حكيم﴾: الله is the mubtadaʾ; عليم is the first khabar, and حكيم the second khabar.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿وإن فاتكم شيء من أزواجكم إلى الكفار﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is a jussive-governing conditional particle; فات is a past verb in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the pronoun of address is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); شيء is the fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma; من أزواجكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) فاتكم; إلى الكفار is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿فات﴾, which has come to include the sense of fleeing and going; and the protasis clause has no grammatical position.
﴿فعاقبتم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; عاقبتم is a past verb and its fāʿil; and the clause has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the protasis clause.
﴿فآتوا الذين ذهبت أزواجهم﴾: the fāʾ is in the apodosis of the condition; آتوا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil; الذين is a relative noun in the position of an accusative as the first mafʿūl bihi; ذهبت is a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine; أزواجهم is the fāʿil, nominative by the ḍamma, and the pronoun is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause ﴿ذهبت أزواجهم﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿مثل﴾: the mafʿūl bihi, accusative by the fatḥa.
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿أنفقوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun; the clause ﴿فآتوا﴾ is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), joined with the fāʾ; and the whole conditional sentence has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the preceding conditional sentence.
﴿واتقوا الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اتقوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is in the position of a nominative as fāʿil; and the Word of Majesty (lafẓ al-jalāla) is the mafʿūl bihi, accusative by the fatḥa.
﴿الذي﴾: a relative noun in the position of an accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of the name of Allah; and the clause is in the position of a jussive, being conjoined to the apodosis.
﴿أنتم به مؤمنون﴾: أنتم is a pronoun in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); به is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿مؤمنون﴾; مؤمنون is the khabar (predicate), nominative by the wāw; and the nominal clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿يا أيها النبي﴾: يا is a vocative particle; أي is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of an accusative (manṣūb); ها is for drawing attention (tanbīh); and النبي is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾.
﴿إذا جاءك المؤمنات﴾: إذا is a future adverb (ẓarf) that includes the sense of condition; the clause جاءك is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) through the adverb's being annexed to it; the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and المؤمنات is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿يبايعنك﴾: يبايعنك is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because it is joined to the nūn of the feminine plural (nūn al-niswa); the nūn is the fāʿil and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi; and the clause is circumstantial (a ḥāl), i.e. "in the state of their seeking the pledge".
﴿على أن لا يشركن بالله شيئا﴾: على is a preposition; ﴿أن﴾ is a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; ﴿لا﴾ is negative; ﴿يشركن﴾ is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because it is joined to the nūn of the feminine plural, in the position of an accusative. أن together with what falls in its scope is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of a genitive by ﴿على﴾, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يبايعنك﴾. In ﴿بالله﴾ the bāʾ is a preposition and the Word of Majesty (lafẓ al-jalāla) is a genitive noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يشركن﴾. ﴿شيئًا﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi, or a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The clause ﴿لا يشركن﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the maṣdar-forming ﴿أن﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولا يسرقن ولا يزنين ولا يقتلن أولادهن﴾: ﴿لا﴾ is negative; ﴿يسرقن﴾ is an imperfect verb in the position of an accusative by conjunction with يشركن; the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil, in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ); and the clause ﴿يسرقن﴾ has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila of the maṣdar-forming ﴿أن﴾. ﴿ولا يزنين ولا يقتلن﴾: the two clauses have no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila clause. ﴿أولادهن﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi, accusative by the fatḥa, and the pronoun is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿ولا يأتين ببهتان يفترينه﴾: ﴿لا﴾ is negative; ﴿يأتين﴾ is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of a nominative [Translator's note: so in the source; on the source's own analysis of the parallel verbs يشركن and يسرقن above, its position would be accusative], and the nūn is in the position of a nominative as fāʿil; ﴿ببهتان﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يأتين﴾; the clause has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila clause; ﴿يفترينه﴾ is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of a nominative; the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil; and the hāʾ is a pronoun in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi.
﴿بين أيديهن وأرجلهن﴾: ﴿بين﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf), accusative by the fatḥa, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the mafʿūl bihi; ﴿أيديهن﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, and the pronoun is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿وأرجلهن﴾ is conjoined to أيديهن, genitive by the kasra; and the clause ﴿يفترينه﴾ is in the position of a genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿بهتان﴾.
﴿ولا يعصينك﴾: conjoined to لا يشركن; ﴿لا﴾ is negative; ﴿يعصينك﴾ is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of a nominative; the nūn is in the position of a nominative as fāʿil; and the kāf is in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi.
﴿في معروف﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يعصينك﴾; and the clause ﴿لا يعصينك﴾ has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila clause.
﴿فبايعهن﴾: the fāʾ is in the apodosis of the condition إذا; the imperative verb is indeclinable on the sukūn; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); the feminine-plural pronoun is in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the whole conditional sentence has no grammatical position, because it is the answer to the vocative; and the vocative clause has no grammatical position, because it is resumptive.
﴿واستغفر لهن الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; استغفر is an imperative verb; ﴿لهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿استغفر﴾; and the Word of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿إن الله غفور رحيم﴾: the clause gives the reason for the command to seek forgiveness.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: يا is a vocative particle; أي is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of an accusative (manṣūb); ها is for drawing attention (tanbīh); الذين is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾; and the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿لا تتولوا قوما غضب الله عليهم﴾: لا is prohibitive; تتولوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; قومًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause غضب الله عليهم is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿قومًا﴾.
﴿قد يئسوا من الآخرة كما يئس الكفار من أصحاب القبور﴾: the clause is a second naʿt of ﴿قومًا﴾, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) after it has been described; قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); يئسوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); من الآخرة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يئسوا﴾; in ﴿كما﴾ the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), and ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdar-forming; يئس الكفار is a verb and its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿ما﴾ and the verb is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿يئس الكفار...﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the maṣdar-forming ﴿ما﴾; ﴿من أصحاب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl from الكفار, i.e. "being among the people of the graves", or attached to يئس, i.e. "they despaired of the resurrection of the people of the graves". ﴿القبور﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi.
